verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project and task management tool, not a code hosting, code review, or coding-agent product. Reviewing an AI agent's code diffs with line-level comments and having the agent iterate falls outside its category. Nothing in the evidence (Power-Ups, the REST API, the MCP server, AI writing help) shows Trello shipping code review or agent iteration, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
